verdict.rationale: Plugging MCP servers into a voice agent as tool sources is a fair question for a voice-agent framework, but the pack never documents Pipecat acting as an MCP client. The only MCP mention is the context-hub CLI registering itself as an MCP server for coding agents, which is a different role. The Flows function docs cover hand-defined functions, not MCP-sourced toolsets.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
